entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup can not determine the local application data directory (WSL, Ubuntu 26.04) #54509
  • dotnetup crashes without ICU libs on Linux, but the requirement is not documented anywhere #54508
  • Migrate xUnit test project templates to xUnit v3 #54499

Closed

  • [Known Build Error] xUnit v3 catastrophic failure: Test process did not return valid JSON #54146
  • Dotnetup: Support installing daily builds via channel #54298
  • Create documentation for internal preview release #54256
  • Create install scripts that use GitHub Releases #54255
  • Create process to release dotnetup via GitHub Releases #54254
  • dotnetup: Duplicate installs shown in system install migration list #53841
  • dotnetup: Add `dotnetup migrate` command for system-to-local install conversion #53839
  • Running dotnetup with no arguments should be the same as running "dotnetup sdk install" #53281
  • GenAPI omits explicitly implemented interface events from generated reference source #54464
  • `dotnet test` for MTP throws hard-to-interpret KeyNotFoundException #51608

PullRequests

Created

  • Dotnetup: Modify PowerShell profile on Windows #54520
  • fix(templates): conditionally omit package versions when CPM is active #54519
    Area-Common templates
  • Restructure CI/CD: skip Official builds on push, add weekly schedule, publish assets #54518
    Area-Infrastructure
  • fix(analyzers): exclude operators from CA1822 false positive #54517
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
  • Parameterize CodeCoverage test on IncludeTestAssembly (#52029) #54514
  • Add per-assembly test counts to dotnet test summary (#52128) #54513
  • Tune Helix partitioning: TargetOS/TargetArchitecture and NetAnalyzers multiplier #54512
  • Fix configure toolset dotnetup lookup executable extension #54511
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54506
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54505
  • Remove the package zip cache download #54503
  • Surface and re-print handshake failures in dotnet test #54501
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54500
  • Document testworkloadsetversions.json in MSI installation tests README #54498

Merged

  • Bump Microsoft.Build.Traversal from 3.4.0 to 4.1.82 #54082
    Area-Infrastructure, dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Convert issue templates to forms and add new dotnetup issue form #54507
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Reduce Helix work items with platform-aware partitioning #54502
  • Migrate GenerateDepsFile to IMultiThreadableTask #53950
  • Isolate InfoCommandTests so WithList variants don't read user state #54496
  • Fix GenAPI omitting explicitly implemented interface events #54492
    11.0-preview6
  • Fix KeyNotFoundException in TerminalTestReporter.AssemblyRunCompleted (#51608) #54437
    11.0-preview6
  • File-based apps: support `#:include .dll` by default #54396
    Area-run-file, 11.0-preview6
  • Add explicit migration support to dotnetup install #53909
    dotnetup

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #54484
  • Fix `dotnetup` telemetry to match old data format following `data-x-migration` new `Lens` `Router` deleting data #54473
  • Exclude scoped CSS assets from publish #54497
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Replace ubuntu22 VM and Helix images with Azure Linux 3 #53792
    Branch Lockdown
  • Improve empty `TargetFramework` diagnostic with dedicated NETSDK1241 #54335
  • `dotnetup` verifies release signatures #54300
    dotnetup
  • Update template `--allow-scripts` help text with explicit trust warning and propagate localization source updates #54393
  • Enable 'dotnet sdk check' command in AOT native binary #54391
    Area-CLI
  • Add `dotnet test` device selection support for MAUI #54295
  • Use suppressors when applying code fixes #53268
  • Add binlog workspace support to dotnet-format #53107
    Area-Infrastructure, stale
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54419
  • File-based apps: ensure shebang analyzer only applies to `#:include` #54397
    Area-run-file
  • Trim whitespace and support exclusion patterns in --test-modules #54432
  • Add specific error types for known dotnetup failure paths #54475
  • Add AOT support for dotnet sln list, migrate, and remove #54384
    Area-CLI
  • Fix DefaultVerificationExcludePatterns to use ** for recursive matching #54390
  • Migrate ProcessFrameworkReferences to IMultiThreadableTask #53945
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Migrate ResolveTargetingPackAssets to IMultiThreadableTask #53944
  • Migrate GetPackageDirectory #54444
  • Migrate ResolvePackageFileConflicts to IMultiThreadableTask #53943
  • Sync MTP IPC DiscoveredTest schema with microsoft/testfx #54445
  • Add DOTNET_TEST_RUNNER environment variable to select the test runner #54482
  • Allow `dotnet test --list-tests json` for Microsoft.Testing.Platform #54490
    Area-CLI
  • Show currently running tests in dotnet test MTP output (#49712) #54486
  • Add --use-current-runtime / --ucr support to dotnet test (MTP) #54495
    Area-CLI
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54410
    Area-CodeFlow
